unknown_feed_generator.evidence: Historical/current V175 records contain WooCommerce/plugin-stack information, but no sufficiently strong feed-generator fingerprint. These sites receive all known public feed-family hypotheses as lower-priority guesses.

acceptance: A candidate is a verified native feed only when the current same-host payload contains the Google Merchant namespace plus a real product item with g:id, g:title, g:link and g:price. Sitemaps, generic RSS/Atom, Store API reconstruction and guessed filenames without payload validation are not native-feed evidence.
safety: Public read-only only. No authentication, CAPTCHA solving, Cloudflare challenge bypass, clearance-cookie replay, proxy evasion or stealth logic.
